test_cases.name: todo_service
test_cases.description: Simple TODO API service - 7 functions, single service, no external integrations
test_objectives: Validate basic setup workflow works end-to-end
Test functional analysis on simple system
Verify tool/workflow alignment on greenfield project
Ensure no critical friction points in happy path

test_cases.name: architecture_drift_sync
test_cases.description: E-commerce order system with injected test failures causing architecture drift - validates D-06.5 synchronization loop and service contracts
test_objectives: Validate Agent B detects architecture drift at D-06 (similarity < 0.95)
Verify Agent B triggers D-06.5 Architecture Synchronization Loop (not skips to D-07)
Ensure Agent B generates service contracts (D-02-A05) and validates them throughout development
Verify service contracts warn Agent B before making breaking changes to functions/interfaces
Validate Agent B uses version_architecture.py tool (not manual versioning)
Ensure Agent B classifies root causes of drift (operational_reality, requirements_creep, technical_constraints)
Verify Agent B updates functional architecture, service architecture, and interface registry consistently
Validate Agent B iterates D-06.5 loop until similarity >= 0.95
Ensure version history documents WHY changes were made (not just WHAT changed)
Verify final D-Post-A02 quality gate passes with synchronized architecture
validation_checkpoints: Checkpoint 3: Root causes classified for all changes
Checkpoint 9: Service contracts generated and validated
Checkpoint 10: Contract warnings triggered before breaking changes

contract_validation_steps: D-02-A05: Generate contracts after domain model
D-04-A06.5: Validate contracts after integration surfaces
D-06.5-A04.5: Regenerate contracts when architecture changes

validates_features: v3.17.0: Service Interface Contracts (proactive drift prevention)
Semantic versioning with root cause classification
Iterative synchronization until similarity threshold met

test_cases.name: artifact_cleanup_removals
test_cases.description: E-commerce payment service with function removals (redundant, superseded by external) - validates D-06.5-A02.5 & D-06.5-A03.5 artifact cleanup
test_objectives: Validate Agent B detects REMOVALS at D-06 (architecture > implementation)
Verify Agent B executes D-06.5-A02.5 (Identify Obsolete Artifacts)
Verify Agent B executes D-06.5-A03.5 (Remove Obsolete Artifacts)
Ensure Agent B removes obsolete functions from architecture files
Ensure Agent B updates service contracts (6→4 functions)
Ensure Agent B deletes obsolete ICD files
Ensure Agent B cleans up tests referencing removed functions
Ensure Agent B updates docker-compose.yml (removes TaxService)
Ensure Agent B provides docker cleanup commands (USER PAIN POINT)
Verify version history documents removals with rationale (not just additions)
Validate similarity >= 0.95 after cleanup (ideally 1.00)
validation_checkpoints: Checkpoint 6: Docker cleaned (P1) - USER PAIN POINT
user_pain_points_addressed: Tests still try to use old/obsolete methods
Container running old image - need to recreate it
